title: ORBITAL_REFINERY_STATUS
author: Torpol Infrastructure Bulletin
content:
PUBLIC INFRASTRUCTURE BULLETIN
Last Updated: 36 Hours Ago
Classification: Public

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Orbital Chemical Refinery #7 is currently OFFLINE
pending investigation of a reported mechanical incident.

Temporary delays in industrial chemical exports are
expected. Affected shipping firms have been notified
and alternative routing is being coordinated.

No impact to tourist experience or passenger
refueling capacity has been observed at this time.

Public safety rating remains UNCHANGED.
Downport operations continue at full capacity.

Passengers are reminded that orbital tours in Sector 7
are temporarily suspended as a precautionary measure.

We thank all visitors for their patience during this
routine operational review.

    — Torpol Port Authority
    — Orbital Infrastructure Division

[NOTE: No mention of external interference.
 Incident classified as mechanical failure.]
